# Validate inputs
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("Boolean threshold not allowed")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("Threshold must be finite nonnegative")
    for name, arr in [("logp_with_result", logp_with_result), 
                      ("logp_call_only", logp_call_only), 
                      ("logp_no_call", logp_no_call)]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray) or arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D numpy array")
        if arr.size == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} cannot be empty")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)) or np.any(arr > 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must contain only finite nonpositive values")
    # Check shapes match
    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("All input matrices must have the same shape")
    
    n_candidates, future_horizon = logp_with_result.shape
    
    # Compute normalized weights
    t = np.arange(future_horizon, dtype=float)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0, 1 - 0.2 * t)
    norm_weights = raw_weights / raw_weights.sum()
    
    # Compute weighted negative log probability losses
    loss_plus = -np.dot(logp_with_result, norm_weights)
    loss_call_only = -np.dot(logp_call_only, norm_weights)
    loss_no_call = -np.dot(logp_no_call, norm_weights)
    
    # Counterfactual baseline
    L_minus = np.minimum(loss_no_call, loss_call_only)
    margins = L_minus - loss_plus
    keep_mask = margins >= tau_filter
    
    return keep_mask, margins
